name: ArtScience Museum
scope: ArtScience Museum at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore, as photographed in February 2013. Includes the ten white petals, central oculus, splayed support columns and ground-level entrance pavilion.

references.filename: ArtScience Museum View from Merlion Park 20130210.JPG

originalReview.notes: The original westward viewpoint from Merlion Park shows the asymmetric height and curvature of the white petals, dark splayed supports, recessed lower entrance and greenish end glazing.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The February 2013 Qualla photograph is byte-identical to the Wikimedia original and was provided as own work and CC0 by the original uploader 玄史生. It shows the exhibit roof from directly across Marina Bay.
